metaDescription: White-label WordPress and Bricks website for Redwinged Media, a paid ads agency: one-page layout, comparison table, pricing toggle, FAQ and client login.
summary: One-page WordPress website for a paid advertising and ad creative agency.
overview: Redwinged Media is an ad agency that describes itself as focused on creative services and paid advertising, with flat-rate pricing. Pixel2Tech built Redwinged Media's WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency. The site tells the agency's story, lays out its plans and sends visitors to schedule a call.
challenge: The agency's pitch rests on being different from other agencies, so the site had to make that comparison easy to follow. It also publishes full plan pricing and a long FAQ, which can turn a single page into a wall of text.
approach: The site is one long page with anchor links for About, Services, Pricing and FAQ, plus a Login button to the client portal and a red Schedule a Call button. A hero headline cycles its last word over a video, followed by the agency's story, a two-column comparison against other agencies, five service sections, a monthly or quarterly pricing toggle across three plans and an accordion FAQ. GSAP drives the scroll animations.
outcome: A single page where a business owner can read who the agency is, how it compares, what each plan includes and how it works, then book a call. The Bricks build keeps sections easy for the agency to edit as plans and copy change.

process.title: One-page structure
process.body: Header links jump to the About, Services, Pricing and FAQ sections, while Login opens the client portal and Schedule a Call goes to a separate contact page.

process.title: Story and comparison
process.body: After a hero headline that rotates its final word, the page tells the agency's origin story, lists its principles and sets other agencies against its own approach point by point.

process.title: Services and pricing
process.body: Strategy, creative, management, reporting and optimization each get a block, and three plan cards switch between monthly and quarterly billing with a toggle.

process.title: FAQ and mobile
process.body: Questions about fit, creative, budgets, reporting and contracts sit in an accordion, and on phones the headline and video stack under a compact logo and menu icon.

whyItMatters: Agencies that publish pricing are asking visitors to self-qualify. Putting the comparison, plans and answers on one scrolling page lets a prospect decide quickly whether to book a call.

faqs.q: What is the Redwinged Media website built with?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with the Bricks Builder theme, uses GSAP for scroll animations and Rank Math for SEO settings.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build websites and Shopify stores under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
